'''Talpini''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to [[Tal Pi]]. [[Weeteef Cyu-Bee]], a member of the [[Partisans]], was a member of this species.

==Biology and appearance==
The Talpini were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] of diminutive [[humanoid]]s [[Homeworld|native]] to [[Tal Pi]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Timelines">[[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]]</ref> Talpini possessed a coat of fur and a downturned [[mouth]] with at least one row of sharp [[Tooth|teeth]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> Talpini could have brown,<ref name="Droid Hunters" /> orange,<ref name="Jango Fett" /> pink,<ref name="Life Day 1" /> tan,<ref name="SWA6" /> or lightly [[color]]ed skin and had<ref name="Visual Guide" /> black,<ref name="The Rising Storm" /> brown,<ref name="Battlefront II" /> gray,<ref name="Droid Hunters" /> orange,<ref name="Beckett" /> or white colored [[hair]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> The Talpini's small size let them conceal themselves easily among taller beings.<ref name="Alien Archive" />

==Talpini in the galaxy==
[[File:Talpini_-_Alien_Archive.jpg|thumb|left|149px|A Talpini soldier]]
[[Zeetar]] was a Talpini who lived during the [[High Republic Era]]. As a member of the [[Nihil]], Zeetar was one of the three [[Tempest Runner]]s and created several inventions such as the [[Scav droid]]s and a [[Power armor|powersuit]] to stand at equal footing with [[Pan Eyta]].<ref name="The Rising Storm" />

[[Weeteef Cyu-Bee]], a [[Gender|male]] Talpini, served as one of the most destructive members of the [[Partisans]], led by [[Saw Gerrera]]. Cyu-Bee contributed with the Partisans in an extended [[Jedha insurgency|campaign]] against the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] occupation of [[Jedha]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />

"[[Steely Carl]]," a male Talpini, worked as a guard for [[Oga Garra]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]].<ref name="Galaxy's Edge: Black Spire">''[[Galaxy's Edge: Black Spire]]''</ref>
